communityMaps.name: Abandoned Places
communityMaps.author: Monobani
communityMaps.description: Explore a world of forgotten relics with this map, featuring lost and abandoned structures from across the globe. Each location confines you to a single, eerie space, inviting you to carefully investigate your surroundings and think outside the box to uncover hidden stories.

communityMaps.name: Modern Brutalism
communityMaps.author: Monobani
communityMaps.description: Monobani compiled a list of locations featuring modern-brutalist architecture. All of them are curated to have an aesthetic appeal and invite the player to delve into the history that shapes the way we design our public spaces.

communityMaps.name: Indoor
communityMaps.author: Zander
communityMaps.description: Rather than getting caught himself, our favourite fish definitely caught my eye with this amazing map. Most of our community prefers the inside world in real life, so why not create a map that perfectly suits the needs of these gamers?

communityMaps.name: Mountains
communityMaps.author: Blockween
communityMaps.description: Whether you like big and spiky or small and smooth mountains, Blockween's map satisfys the needs of even the most fanatic mountain enthusiasts. This map is not only suitable for those who crave the thrill of reaching new heights in real life, but also gamers who want to impress their relatives with a half-true story about their amazing hiking trip.

communityMaps.name: Racetracks
communityMaps.author: Magnus1stcool
communityMaps.description: Magnus is the ultimate racing aficionado. Not a single race escapes his keen eye - he can name them all off the top of his head. His collection of circuits is a testament to his passion, meticulously curated, presumably even without the need for google searches.

communityMaps.name: Skyscrapers
communityMaps.author: QwidziT
communityMaps.description: Do you remember how obsessed you were with mega structures when you were a kid? No matter the age, everybody loves tall shiny buildings – skyscrapers – and this map is full of these magnificent beauties. Furthermore, this map is perfectly suited towards beginners, as you'll always have a tall navigational aid.

communityMaps.name: Stadiums
communityMaps.author: Falip
communityMaps.description: Falip introduced himself to the discord server with this amazing stadium map. It includes a huge variety of stadium locations, satisfying even the most diehard sports fans. Can you name them all?

communityMaps.name: Wetherspoon Pubs
communityMaps.author: Jdawg
communityMaps.description: It doesn't matter whether it's a Whetherspoon located in the center of London or at the edge of Norwhich, chances are, Jdawg has seen it - at least digitally. It's still unknown where his affinity for british pubs is coming from, but I for sure hope it isn't a sign of an alcohol addiction.

communityMaps.name: Airports
communityMaps.author: Kris Wiggle & A2IN
communityMaps.description: Take a global tour of the world's most bustling airports with this detailed map by Kris Wiggle & A2IN. Perfect for aviation enthusiasts, it captures the unique architectural styles and vibrant atmospheres of international terminals, from the busiest hubs to hidden gems.

communityMaps.name: Bridges
communityMaps.author: mysza_pipisza
communityMaps.description: Discover a stunning collection of bridges from around the world with mysza_pipisza's map. From historic stone structures to modern engineering marvels, this map celebrates the beauty and ingenuity of bridge design.

communityMaps.name: Religious Sites
communityMaps.author: ספרו
communityMaps.description: Explore the spiritual and architectural wonders of the world with this map of religious sites. Each location offers a glimpse into the diverse practices and sacred spaces that define different cultures and faiths.

communityMaps.name: Windmills
communityMaps.author: BuckDewey
communityMaps.description: Step into the charming world of windmills with BuckDewey's map. Featuring picturesque windmills from various regions, this map is perfect for those who appreciate the rustic beauty and historical significance of these iconic structures.
